sections.title: Culture and Politics in Authoritarian Brazil
sections.description: This course will explore the cultural and political life of Brazil during the last military dictatorship (1964-1985) through literature, film, popular music, visual arts, and archival documents. We will discuss regime change, authoritarianism, censorship, cultural resistance, revolutionary politics, human rights violations, and the return to democracy, with an eye to its long-term effects in contemporary Brazil. Instruction of this course is not in English.
